from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def _find_idempotent(event: str, idempotency_key):
    if idempotency_key is None:
        return None
    for entry in audit.events(event):
        if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
            return entry
    return None


def authorize(
    payment_id: str,
    invoice: Invoice,
    amount,
    at: datetime,
    *,
    idempotency_key=None,
) -> Payment:
    existing = _find_idempotent("payment_authorized", idempotency_key)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing["payment"]
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    payment = Payment(id=payment_id, invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, created_at=ensure_utc(at))
    audit.record(
        "payment_authorized",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        payment=payment,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment


def capture_partial(
    payment: Payment,
    amount,
    at: datetime,
    *,
    idempotency_key=None,
) -> Payment:
    """Capture part of an authorized payment."""
    existing = _find_idempotent("payment_captured", idempotency_key)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing["payment"]
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "authorized":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError("amount_exceeds_authorized", str(amount))
    payment.amount = amount
    payment.captured_at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.status = "captured"
    audit.record(
        "payment_captured",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        payment=payment,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment

        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    payment = Payment(id=payment_id, invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, created_at=ensure_utc(at))
    audit.record(
        "payment_authorized",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        payment=payment,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment


def capture_partial(
    payment: Payment,
    amount,
    at: datetime,
    *,
    idempotency_key=None,
) -> Payment:
    """Capture part of an authorized payment."""
    existing = _find_idempotent("payment_captured", idempotency_key)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing["payment"]
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "authorized":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError("amount_exceeds_authorized", str(amount))
    payment.amount = amount
    payment.captured_at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.status = "captured"
    audit.record(
        "payment_captured",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        payment=payment,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment
